purpose: Paired evaluation of feedforward ViT-S checkpoints (ff_112 seeds 17, 42, 99) wrapped with the flagship's spatial gaze sampler and recurrent fusion at test time vs single-view ff on the same images, attacked end-to-end. The control omits the refine block and the gist step, so EXPLAINS means 'multi-view averaging suffices', not 'the full flagship mechanism'.
hypothesis: Does the observed robustness difference between feedforward (ff_112) and flagship (recurrence_112 seed 42) stem from recurrent state dynamics per se, or simply from multi-view spatial sampling and feature integration?

wrapper_specification.fusion_mechanism: Flagship fixed-EMA recurrence: z_0 = g_0; z_t = 0.5 * z_{t-1} + 0.5 * g_t for t in 1..3
wrapper_specification.trunk_and_head: Imported from trained ff_112 checkpoints (backbone + cls_head)
wrapper_specification.attack_surface: End-to-end differentiable forward pass through foveal_sample, ViT backbone, and fusion into classification head

threat_model.evaluation_slice: full 5k for primary; 1k subset for sanity checks

per_sample_arrays.description: For both multi-view ff and single-view ff on the SAME 5k indices, build per-sample worst-case boolean arrays over primary attacks (clean AND PGD-50 AND APGD-CE AND APGD-DLR). Also record clean.

paired_design.delta_per_seed: delta_mv_seed = WC(multi-view ff, seed) - WC(single-view ff, seed) on the same images (pp). Also report clean delta.

bootstrap.method: paired bootstrap over images with the SAME resampled indices across seeds

EXPLAINS.condition: mean delta_mv >= 1.0 pp AND the paired bootstrap 95% CI (resampling images) excludes 0
EXPLAINS.description: Multi-view averaging suffices (control omits refine block and gist step).

NO-EFFECT-SEEN.description: Reported as inconclusive for the explanation because ff_112 was never trained on shifted views (feedforward weights trained exclusively on centered inputs; test-time shifted glimpses are out-of-distribution).

reporting_requirements.clean_accuracy: Report clean accuracy alongside robust worst-case/deltas to quantify clean distribution shift.
attack_sanity_checks: PGD-100 on 1k subset vs PGD-50: assert PGD-100 <= PGD-50 within standard numerical margin (checks gradient masking / step saturation).
APGD-T on 1k subset vs APGD-CE: verify targeted and untargeted APGD produce concordant bounds.
